consensus_expectations: Frozen FQ3 consensus is US$5,936.74m revenue (+42.3% year over year) and US$0.22164 GAAP EPS (+39.0%). Target mean/median/range are US$18.78/US$19.00/US$10.00-US$23.00. FY2026 last-month revisions are 8 up/0 down for EPS and 5 up/2 down for revenue. The governance snapshot lists 33 contributors, but the exact count behind each FQ3 line is not proven.
market_implied_expectations: At US$14.30, a residual-income model using the disclosed 16.51% Brazil Investments CGU rate requires 47.36% terminal ROE or 80.89% FY2027-30 profit CAGR. The same earnings path reconciles at a 9.78% group-implied cost of equity, so price requires exceptional returns/growth duration or a much lower group hurdle than the CGU rate.
engine_view: Engine 12-month bull/base/bear values are US$8.43/US$6.47/US$4.40. The US$6.47 base equally blends US$7.38 peer NTM-P/E and US$5.55 residual income; the full field is US$2.95-US$7.92. A 10% US$18.78 consensus tail still leaves a US$7.472 weighted target and -47.7483% expected return.
what_everyone_knows: Nu is a fast-growing Latin American digital bank: Q2 had 139m customers, 83.5% activity, 50.3% revenue growth and 66.3% diluted-EPS growth; sell-side estimates remain constructive.
what_is_priced_in: US$14.30 prices continued high growth and returns or a group cost of equity near 9.78%. The US$18.78 target mean and positive FY2026 revisions show that strong execution is not hidden.
what_market_may_be_missing: Credit-income gains may precede the full loss outcome, and a US$991.046m H1 deferred-tax benefit makes headline net income less cash-backed. These facts may reduce durability but do not prove a miss or improper accounting.
evidence_engine_is_different: There is no proven variant perception yet. It would be proven only by a sourced group cost of equity materially above 9.78% plus a Q3 revenue/EPS miss or worse credit quality. That evidence is absent at the decision date, while Q2 and estimate revisions point the other way.
base_rate_check: The run has no adequate empirical reference class for Nu-like digital lenders sustaining high growth and 30%+ returns across a full credit cycle. Scenario probabilities are properly labeled judgment. Mature-bank anchors may be conservative, but extrapolating Q2 would also lack exceptional proof.
notes: The US$6.47 base is 54.755245% below US$14.30, but the gap is not robust: methods span 168%, 16.51% is not a group rate, 9.78% reconciles price, consensus points upward and no short implementation evidence exists. This final audit pins the post-haircut decision bytes and remains below the decision record's edge_score=45.
